qd-uv.alt: Ten vials of CdSe quantum dots glowing blue, cyan, green, yellow, orange and red under UV light
qd-uv.caption: Under UV excitation the ten aliquots fluoresce from deep blue to orange-red: quantum confinement, visible.

qd-visible.alt: The same quantum-dot vials under room light, shifting from colourless to orange-red
qd-visible.caption: Same samples under visible light: colourless at 8 s, orange-red by 10 min.

qd-stem.alt: Scanning transmission electron micrograph showing CdSe nanocrystals as dark dots, 10 nm scale bar
qd-stem.caption: STEM at ×1,000,000 (30 kV, TED): measured diameter 4.125 nm vs 4.03 nm predicted by the Yu et al. model, a 2.4% discrepancy.

qd-emission-time.alt: Scatter plot of emission wavelength rising with withdrawal time for three oleic acid volumes
qd-emission-time.caption: Peak emission vs withdrawal time for 0.3, 0.6 and 0.9 mL oleic acid.

qd-pl.alt: Normalised photoluminescence spectra shifting right with reaction time
qd-pl.caption: Photoluminescence red-shifts with reaction time: 436.33 nm to 582.49 nm.

qd-abs.alt: UV-Vis absorbance spectra for standard and increased oleic acid samples
qd-abs.caption: UV-Vis absorption: the excitonic peak red-shifts as confinement weakens in larger crystals.

qd-abs-em.alt: Overlaid absorbance and emission curves for two samples
qd-abs-em.caption: Absorption vs emission peaks, standard vs 0.9 mL oleic acid.

dsa-afm-grid.alt: Nine AFM height maps of block copolymer patterns in trenches and circular wells
dsa-afm-grid.caption: AFM topography across all nine templates: trenches (a–f) and circular wells (g–i).

dsa-sem-grid.alt: Nine SEM images of PS-b-PMMA patterns inside trenches and wells, 1 µm scale bars
dsa-sem-grid.caption: SEM across all nine templates: trench widths 20–280 nm and well diameters 140–240 nm.

dsa-sem-a.alt: SEM image of block copolymer self-assembly in a 20 nm trench
dsa-sem-a.caption: SEM (a) 20 nm trench. Single, perfectly straight cylinder row: width is commensurate with 0.5 L0.

dsa-sem-b.alt: SEM image of block copolymer self-assembly in a 70 nm trench
dsa-sem-b.caption: SEM (b) 70 nm trench. Cylinders begin to align parallel to the trench walls.

dsa-sem-c.alt: SEM image of block copolymer self-assembly in a 120 nm trench
dsa-sem-c.caption: SEM (c) 120 nm trench. Highest uniformity: a clean 3-row cylinder array.

dsa-sem-d.alt: SEM image of block copolymer self-assembly in a 140 nm trench
dsa-sem-d.caption: SEM (d) 140 nm trench. Sits between the commensurate 3-row (120 nm) and 4-row (160 nm) widths.

dsa-sem-e.alt: SEM image of block copolymer self-assembly in a 210 nm trench
dsa-sem-e.caption: SEM (e) 210 nm trench. Transition toward a mixed lamellar morphology near 200 nm.

dsa-sem-f.alt: SEM image of block copolymer self-assembly in a 280 nm trench
dsa-sem-f.caption: SEM (f) 280 nm trench. Walls too far apart for global control: grain boundaries in the centre.

dsa-sem-g.alt: SEM image of block copolymer self-assembly in a 140 nm well
dsa-sem-g.caption: SEM (g) 140 nm well. Confinement stress: overlapping chains, no ordered array.

dsa-sem-h.alt: SEM image of block copolymer self-assembly in a 180 nm well
dsa-sem-h.caption: SEM (h) 180 nm well. Commensurate diameter: exactly 12 discrete microdomains per well.

dsa-sem-i.alt: SEM image of block copolymer self-assembly in a 240 nm well
dsa-sem-i.caption: SEM (i) 240 nm well. Thinnest film of any well (~36 nm): starved of polymer, domains become incomplete or distorted.

dsa-afm-a.alt: AFM height map of block copolymer self-assembly in a 20 nm trench
dsa-afm-a.caption: AFM (a) 20 nm trench. Single, perfectly straight cylinder row: width is commensurate with 0.5 L0.

dsa-afm-b.alt: AFM height map of block copolymer self-assembly in a 70 nm trench
dsa-afm-b.caption: AFM (b) 70 nm trench. Cylinders begin to align parallel to the trench walls.

dsa-afm-c.alt: AFM height map of block copolymer self-assembly in a 120 nm trench
dsa-afm-c.caption: AFM (c) 120 nm trench. Highest uniformity: a clean 3-row cylinder array.

dsa-afm-d.alt: AFM height map of block copolymer self-assembly in a 140 nm trench
dsa-afm-d.caption: AFM (d) 140 nm trench. Sits between the commensurate 3-row (120 nm) and 4-row (160 nm) widths.

dsa-afm-e.alt: AFM height map of block copolymer self-assembly in a 210 nm trench
dsa-afm-e.caption: AFM (e) 210 nm trench. Transition toward a mixed lamellar morphology near 200 nm.

dsa-afm-f.alt: AFM height map of block copolymer self-assembly in a 280 nm trench
dsa-afm-f.caption: AFM (f) 280 nm trench. Walls too far apart for global control: grain boundaries in the centre.

dsa-afm-g.alt: AFM height map of block copolymer self-assembly in a 140 nm well
dsa-afm-g.caption: AFM (g) 140 nm well. Confinement stress: overlapping chains, no ordered array.

dsa-afm-h.alt: AFM height map of block copolymer self-assembly in a 180 nm well
dsa-afm-h.caption: AFM (h) 180 nm well. Commensurate diameter: exactly 12 discrete microdomains per well.

dsa-afm-i.alt: AFM height map of block copolymer self-assembly in a 240 nm well
dsa-afm-i.caption: AFM (i) 240 nm well. Thinnest film of any well (~36 nm): starved of polymer, domains become incomplete or distorted.

dsa-process.alt: Eight-step diagram of the graphoepitaxy process flow
dsa-process.caption: Process: PECVD oxide, ZEP e-beam lithography at 100 kV, CF4 RIE, brush neutralisation, 240 °C anneal, UV + acetic-acid PMMA removal.

dsa-xsection.alt: Cross-section diagram of block copolymer film filling an etched oxide trench
dsa-xsection.caption: Effective film thickness inside a template depends on etch depth and template width.

dsa-thickness.alt: Two plots of film thickness decreasing linearly with trench width and well diameter
dsa-thickness.caption: Film thins as templates widen: down to ~49 nm in the widest trenches and ~36 nm in 240 nm wells.

gfet-gds.alt: GDS layout of the graphene transistor array with green electrode traces
gfet-gds.caption: GDS layout of the GFET array: TLM structures and sensor channels.

gfet-process.alt: Fifteen-panel process cross-section for electrodes and graphene transfer
gfet-process.caption: Bilayer-resist lithography, Cr/Au lift-off, PMMA-assisted electrochemical graphene transfer, O2 patterning, ALD Al2O3 cap.

gfet-pdms.alt: Six-panel process for the SU-8 mould and PDMS microfluidic channel
gfet-pdms.caption: SU-8 mould, PDMS casting and vacuum bonding of the microfluidic channel over the graphene.

gfet-tlm.alt: Resistance versus channel length with two linear fits, red and blue
gfet-tlm.caption: TLM extraction: sheet resistance fell 66.7% (5.195 to 1.730 kΩ/□) in a week while contact resistance rose 137%.

gfet-dirac.alt: Four transfer curves showing V-shaped Dirac minima at -2, 0, 19 and 3 volts
gfet-dirac.caption: Transfer curves: Dirac points from −2 V to +19 V, traced to local PMMA and water residue rather than channel length.

gfet-ph-droplet.alt: Resistance at pH 4, 7 and 10 for three channel lengths
gfet-ph-droplet.caption: Static-droplet pH test: high resistance at pH 4 (hole depletion), lower at pH 10 (hole accumulation).

gfet-ph-flow.alt: Resistance versus pH for the microfluidic device, two channel lengths
gfet-ph-flow.caption: Continuous-flow test: a V-shaped response attributed to electrode delamination.

mems-sem-cantilever.alt: SEM of a released cantilever array with dimension annotations
mems-sem-cantilever.caption: SEM metrology of the fabricated cantilever array (×180, 5 kV).

mems-sem-comb.alt: SEM of interdigitated comb-drive fingers with length annotations near 70 µm
mems-sem-comb.caption: Comb-drive fingers under SEM (×900): ~70 µm features matching optical metrology.

mems-interferometry.alt: White-light interferometry 3D height map of a cantilever array
mems-interferometry.caption: White-light interferometry: 3D map of a released cantilever array at 0 V.

mems-cantilever-side.alt: Optical side view of a 300 µm cantilever beam
mems-cantilever-side.caption: Optical view of a 300 µm beam used for resonance testing.

mems-gds-comb.alt: GDS layout of a comb-drive actuator variant
mems-gds-comb.caption: GDS: one of 18 comb-drive variants (b = 3.2 µm, d = 2.0 µm).

mems-gds-cantilever.alt: GDS layout of four cantilever arrays with 4, 6, 8 and 10 µm beams
mems-gds-cantilever.caption: GDS: vertical cantilever arrays, 4–10 µm beam widths.

mems-gds-piano.alt: GDS layout of horizontal cantilevers of increasing length
mems-gds-piano.caption: GDS: horizontal 'piano' cantilevers, 50–300 µm long, for resonance tests.

mems-process.alt: Step-by-step SOI MEMS process flow diagram
mems-process.caption: SOI process: Cr hard mask, lithography, DRIE to the BOX, liquid-HF release, critical-point dry, Cr/Au pads.

mems-deflection-cohorts.alt: Dot plot comparing cantilever deflection for 2018 and 2026 cohorts
mems-deflection-cohorts.caption: Despite thinner beams (2.5 vs 3.8 µm), 2026 deflection is comparable to or lower than 2018: curl-induced gap expansion dominates.

mems-static-deflection.alt: Static deflection versus voltage, measured against theory curves
mems-static-deflection.caption: Static deflection tracks CAD theory, far below the flat 2.5 µm prediction (black): the ~12 µm curl widens the gap and pushes pull-in beyond 272 V.

mems-resonance.alt: Resonant frequency falling with beam length, measured and theoretical
mems-resonance.caption: Resonance vs beam length: 21.3% average deviation from Euler-Bernoulli (vs <3.5% for the 2018 cohort).

gyro-schematic.alt: Schematic of a tuning-fork gyroscope with two proof masses and comb drives
gyro-schematic.caption: Tuning-fork gyroscope: anti-phase drive with differential Coriolis sensing and a central anchor.

gyro-process.alt: SOI fabrication process cross-sections for the gyroscope comb drive
gyro-process.caption: Proposed SOI process with a polysilicon anchor plug that survives HF release.

sweep-0.alt: Optical micrograph of the comb-drive actuator at 0 V
sweep-0.caption: Comb drive b2 at 0 V: backbone gap 52.27 µm.

sweep-1.alt: Optical micrograph of the comb-drive actuator at 10 V
sweep-1.caption: Comb drive b2 at 10 V: backbone gap 51.92 µm.

sweep-2.alt: Optical micrograph of the comb-drive actuator at 15 V
sweep-2.caption: Comb drive b2 at 15 V: backbone gap 50.55 µm.

sweep-3.alt: Optical micrograph of the comb-drive actuator at 20 V
sweep-3.caption: Comb drive b2 at 20 V: backbone gap 48.83 µm.

sweep-4.alt: Optical micrograph of the comb-drive actuator at 22 V
sweep-4.caption: Comb drive b2 at 22 V: backbone gap 46.77 µm.

sweep-5.alt: Optical micrograph of the comb-drive actuator at 23.5 V
sweep-5.caption: Comb drive b2 at 23.5 V: backbone gap 38.17 µm.

tia-schematic.alt: Full transimpedance amplifier schematic in Cadence with operating-point annotations
tia-schematic.caption: DC operating point across all stages: common-gate input, six differential gain stages, source-follower buffers.

tia-ac.alt: AC simulation of transimpedance gain falling off near 324 MHz
tia-ac.caption: AC response: 160.9 kΩ transimpedance, −3 dB at 324 MHz, DC-coupled.

tia-transient.alt: Transient differential output sine wave at 300 MHz
tia-transient.caption: Transient: 300 MHz, 2.67 µApp input current driving a 0.503 V differential swing.

tia-noise.alt: Input-referred current noise spectral density plot
tia-noise.caption: Input-referred current noise integrates to 52 nA rms (spec ≤ 125 nA rms).

tia-step.alt: Transient step response with minimal ringing
tia-step.caption: Step response: minimal ringing, confirming phase margin.

tia-idvds.alt: Family of 45 nm transistor drain-current curves versus drain voltage
tia-idvds.caption: 45 nm device characterisation: ID–VDS output curves.

tia-ft.alt: Cadence transition-frequency extraction for the NMOS device
tia-ft.caption: Cadence fT extraction: NMOS 239 GHz (PMOS 183 GHz).

tia-ft-hand.alt: Hand-calculated transition frequency rising with gate voltage for NMOS and PMOS
tia-ft-hand.caption: Hand-calculated fT (NMOS ≈ 365 GHz): square-law models overestimate a velocity-saturated 45 nm device.

sram-bitcell.caption: 6T bit cell: 120 nm / 45 nm devices, 32,400 nm² cell.

sram-decoder.caption: Row decoder built from 4-input NANDs and inverters.

sram-sense.caption: Sense amplifier: cross-coupled regenerative latch, chosen over single-ended stages for lower delay and power.

sram-waves.alt: Simulation waveforms of simultaneous read and write operations
sram-waves.caption: Simultaneous read/write validation waveforms.
